title: Topics in Communications; Introduction to Wireless Networking
description:
Prerequisites: Minimum of C- or better ENEE324 or STAT400; and completion of all lower-division technical courses in the EE curriculum.

An introduction to wireless networking technologies through an in-depth exploration of fundamental architectural and design principles. It covers key concepts, including ALOHA, CSMA, and 802.11, with a focus on their performance analysis using formal analytical methods and realistic simulations. The course leverages the industry and research-relevant NS-3 network simulator to develop and analyze real-world wireless network projects, providing hands-on practical experience.
